pairs: Et ostendit mihi Dominus Jesum sacerdotem magnum,
And the Lord revealed to me: Jesus the high priest,
standing in the sight of the angel of the Lord.
et Satan stabat a dextris ejus ut adversaretur ei.
And Satan stood before his right hand, so as to be his adversary.
And the Lord said to Satan,
And may the Lord, who chose Jerusalem,
qui elegit Jerusalem! numquid non iste torris est erutus de igne?
rebuke you! Are you not a firebrand plucked from the fire?”
Et Jesus erat indutus vestibus sordidis,
And Jesus was clothed with filthy garments.
And he stood before the face of an angel.
He answered and spoke to those who stood before him,
et ait ad eos qui stabant coram se,
“Take away the filthy garments from him.”
Ecce abstuli a te iniquitatem tuam,
I have taken away from you your iniquity,
and I have clothed you with a change of clothing.”
Ponite cidarim mundam super caput ejus.
“Place a clean diadem on his head.”
Et posuerunt cidarim mundam super caput ejus,
And they placed a clean diadem on his head,
and they clothed him with garments.
And the angel of the Lord remained standing.
And the angel of the Lord contested with Jesus,
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
If you will walk in my ways
you likewise will judge my house
et dabo tibi ambulantes de his qui nunc hic assistunt.
and I will give you some of those who now attend here to walk with you.
who have been portending to men.
ecce enim ego adducam servum meum Orientem.
I will lead my servant to the East.
Quia ecce lapis quem dedi coram Jesu:
For behold, the stone that I have bestowed before Jesus.
super lapidem unum septem oculi sunt:
Upon one stone, there are seven eyes.
Behold, I will carve its engraving,
et auferam iniquitatem terræ illius in die una.
And I will take away the iniquity of that land in one day.
vocabit vir amicum suum subter vitem et subter ficum.
every man will call his friend from under the vine and from under the fig tree.
